# Nehemiah 6 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Nehemiah 6 (19 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.3 — "great work" vs. "important project"
- **EMET:** "great work" (*melakhah gedolah*) / **LOGOS:** "great work" / **PNEUMA:** "important project"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "great work" — Literal rendering of *melakhah gedolah*. "Important project" diminishes the theological weight of *melakhah*, which echoes creation and tabernacle language.

---

## V.9 — "strengthen my hands" vs. "give me strength"
- **EMET:** "strengthen my-hands" / **LOGOS:** "O God, strengthen my hands" / **PNEUMA:** "God, give me strength"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Now strengthen my hands, O God" — Preserves the Hebrew body-part idiom (*chazzaq yadai*) while clarifying this is a prayer. PNEUMA's generalization loses the image of hands engaged in building.

---

## V.16 — "fell in their own esteem" vs. "were demoralized"
- **EMET:** "fell greatly in-their-own-eyes" / **LOGOS:** "fell greatly in their own esteem" / **PNEUMA:** "were demoralized and deeply shaken"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "fell greatly in their own esteem" — The Hebrew *va-yippelu be-eyneyhem* means their self-confidence collapsed. PNEUMA adds interpretive expansion not in the text.

---

*— SOPHIA*
